history_detection_limit: All reachable objects checked for listed byte markers. Paths are Git representative paths, not every occurrence; exact removal occurrences require commit/tree enumeration before execution. Marker-free derivatives require manual review.
classification_limit: Structural/text candidate detection, not a legal or exhaustive content determination. Reference-only matches must not be deleted merely for citing a source; textual summaries need item-level review.
history_scope: Locate every historical version containing target data or protected expressions; deleting only current paths is insufficient.
